import sys

def find_parent(parent, x):
    if parent[x] != x:
        parent[x] = find_parent(parent, parent[x])
    return parent[x]

def union(parent, rank, x, y):
    if rank[x] >= rank[y]:
        parent[y] = x
        rank[x] += 1
    else:
        parent[x] = y
        rank[y] += 1

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    P = int(data[0])
    K = int(data[1])

    MOD = 1000000007

    parent = list(range(P + 1))  # 1-indexed, index 0 unused
    rank = [1] * (P + 1)

    # Process edges for i = 1 to P-1 (inclusive)
    for i in range(1, P):
        value = (K * i) % P
        pa = find_parent(parent, i)
        pb = find_parent(parent, value)
        if pa != pb:
            union(parent, rank, pa, pb)

    groups = set()
    for i in range(1, P + 1):
        groups.add(find_parent(parent, i))

    if K == 0:
        ways = pow(P, P - 1, MOD)
    elif K == 1:
        ways = pow(P, P, MOD)
    else:
        ways = pow(P, len(groups), MOD)

    print(ways)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
